messages:
gina: Quick heads-up — quarterly access review shows ~12 staging admin grants tied to folks marked 'on_sabbatical' in HR for >90d. Most are proj-hera-staging-admin and proj-nimbus-staging-admin. Not sure if these were intentionally left for on-call handoffs. Can we triage? I started a small evidence table: https://internal.redwood.com/access-reviews/4765

mohit: Thanks — can you paste a couple audit IDs? I'll run a KMS binding check and look for any direct user principals on keys. If keys were rotated while grants stayed, that'd be odd.

gina: Sample audit IDs: abc123, def456, ghi789. Ran a quick audit query, results look noisy but focused on those roles. ```sql
SELECT principal, role, resource, timestamp
FROM audit_logs
WHERE role LIKE '%staging-admin%'
  AND timestamp > '2025-01-01'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

samir: +1 to removing stale grants. Proposal: soft-handback policy — owner ping for 72h, then auto-remove stale grant. Also add a 'sabbatical-exception' tag for approved exceptions so scans skip them. Mohit, can you verify KMS key ACLs for hera/nimbus and check for any direct user bindings?

mohit: On it. Quick note: many KMS bindings end up via service accounts. I'll run: ```bash
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --keyring=proj-hera-ring --format=json
```
I'll check key policy and rotation timestamps and flag any user principals.

infra-bot: Heads-up — scheduled maintenance for staging next Tue 03:00 UTC. If PR to prune roles is merged before then, infra will apply the change during the window. See #release-war-room for timeline.

tara: :thumbsup: I'm OK with 72h ping-to-remove. I'll own the owner-pings for hera/nimbus, open a PR to strip console-admin -> ops-read, and create a JIRA to track the evidence and approvals (RSEC-7896). I'll add the audit snapshots to the ticket.

gina: Thanks Tara. Mohit — if you find any KMS grants to user principals (instead of SAs), escalate immediately; those need removal and likely key rotation.

mohit: Understood. If I see user principals, I'll rotate keys, update key policies, and file an incident with SRE if there's active use. ETA EOD for initial scan.

samir: Operational note: update runbook at docs/privilege-handback.md to include the 72h policy + automation hook that tags exceptions with 'sabbatical-checked' so future scans can ignore sanctioned entries. Also add a short play for KMS-linked grants.

gina: Great — once Tara opens the PR and Mohit posts KMS findings, we'll run the auto-prune. Thanks all.
